recovery.metric_region: Union of cells with positive population selection response; this is not a claim that all these cells are strongly constrained.
recovery.log_score_baseline: Homogeneous density with zero mean velocity and nuisance prior centres, same geometry, errors, selection and heldout data. These are relative log scores, not coverage tests.

optimizer_findings.joint: Both reached the 200-iteration limit without convergence; these are candidates, not certified modes. Standardized bias parameters rose 5.77-10.55 in the matched case and 1.98-12.67 in the PM case.
optimizer_findings.conditional: Bias fixed to generator values only; all other parameters optimized. Both converged by projected-gradient criterion in 139/137 iterations; max free-coordinate gradients 0.00079874/0.00037092. Physical rho minima 0.16090/0.28718 and mean unity to floating-point precision.
optimizer_findings.comparison_caveat: Conditional runs also use larger L-BFGS history (40 vs10) and a higher iteration cap (400 vs200). Improved results support, but do not isolate or prove, bias degeneracy as the sole cause. Neither a failed joint optimizer nor a successful conditional mode calibrates the joint posterior.
optimizer_findings.analytic_mechanism: Real-space normalized tracer mass is proportional to exp(b*g)/mean(exp(b*g)). Under g->c*g and b->b/c it is invariant, while the physical density exp(g)/mean(exp(g)) changes. Gaussian-white prior cost falls as c^2 but only six bias priors compensate. Velocity/RSD partially break this degeneracy. A high-dimensional joint MAP need not represent the marginal field or bias posterior.
optimizer_findings.scientific_response: Do not tune A(k), shrink LCDM power, silently fix observational bias, or treat the lower joint objective as better physical recovery. Test posterior uncertainty/marginalization explicitly.

remaining_limits: All data used for inference were synthetic. CF4 supplied fixed geometry/error/BGc design; observed vobs was discarded. Actual galaxy-count members were never read.
Independent PM dynamics were used, but both cases share the same coarse observation generator; independent tracer, selection, FoG and RSD systematics remain untested here.
Legacy PM truth recentering adds smoothing: whole-box density SD fell from 0.67547 to 0.48827. The PM comparison is against this explicitly remapped field, not native high-resolution truth.
The lognormal coarse model and potential-flow velocity are approximations, not dynamically consistent nonlinear gravity. There is no IC or reverse evolution implementation in Z4.

MAP maps lack posterior small-scale realizations and are especially smooth where data are weak. Missing structure cannot be attributed solely to a model defect or solely to absent information from these fits.
N32 on a 384 cMpc/h box means 12 cMpc/h. Neither the 1-2 cMpc/h surroundings nor LG-only 0.3 cMpc/h targets have been achieved.

next_recommendation.bundle_purpose: Test a joint z=0 physical-field posterior with bias uncertainty marginalized by sampling, rather than selecting a joint MAP. Reuse these two development data sets and the existing sampler machinery; assess whether bias remains pathological, mean-field recovery, interval calibration and heldout prediction together.
